I am a PhD candidate in [Systems Engineering](https://emse.engineering.gwu.edu/) at [George Washington University](https://www.gwu.edu/), advised by Professor [John Helveston](https://www.jhelvy.com). My work focuses on data science, quantitative modeling, and software development for human behavior and sustainable transportation. I develop open-source software for survey design and discrete choice modeling, and build full-stack research applications with {{< var rlink >}}, {{< var python >}}, {{< var quarto >}}, {{< var shiny >}}, and [PostgreSQL](https://supabase.com). I also apply agentic AI engineering to design and deploy LLM-powered workflows that automate complex research and development tasks.
